mapper.select: select br.id, role_name, role_alias from bedrock_admin_role bar inner join bedrock_role br on bar.role_id = br.id where bar.admin_id = #{adminId} and br.is_deleted = 0
select br.id, role_name, role_alias, sort, remark from bedrock_role br where br.is_deleted = 0 and br.id = #{id}

select br.id, role_name, role_alias, sort, remark, create_time from bedrock_role br where br.is_deleted = 0 and br.role_alias not in (
#{alias} )
and br.role_name like concat('%', #{param.roleName}, '%')
and br.role_alias like concat('%', #{param.roleAlias}, '%')
order by sort
